decision_basis: before root receives or reads finite-target validation results; no target truth used to select policy
width_limit_meaning: 5 percentage points, demonstration project accuracy policy; not mathematical necessity or code requirement
peak_region_status: independent of decision status; overlapping region intervals do not by themselves invalidate whole-window peak classification
operational_recompute: uncertain decision OR width too wide OR invalid interval/baseline; mathematical same-side decision is still recorded separately when width too wide
adverse_action_miss: true D < 0 and decision is meets
no_truth_denominator: no true-adverse case means denominator not applicable, not 0 percent
one_building_all_floors: all floors must meet for whole-building meets; no independence claim for floors or directions
policy_changes: new versions only; do not overwrite or retrospectively select a threshold to improve reported classification
